column6: 子 here is the neutral-tone suffix: qīzi, not qī zǐ. "zǐ" (3rd tone) is simply the wrong syllable, not just the wrong tone mark.
Standard reading has a neutral tone on the second syllable: shìqing, not shìqíng.
Standard reading has a neutral tone on 上: wǎnshang, not wǎnshàng — same neutral-tone pattern as 谢谢.
Standard reading has a neutral tone on the second syllable: yǎnjing, not yǎnjīng.
Standard reading has a neutral tone on the second syllable: yìsi, not yìsī — a classic neutral-tone miss, same pattern as 谢谢.
Standard reading has a neutral tone on 边: yòubian, not yòubiān.
Standard reading has a neutral tone on 上: zǎoshang, not zǎoshàng — same pattern as 晚上 (h2w108).
Standard reading has a neutral tone on 边: zuǒbian, not zuǒbiān. (I left 旁边 as pángbiān, full tone — that one does not take the neutral-边 pattern in standard dictionaries.)
